summary: This is a routine 8-K filed by T. Rowe Price OHA Select Private Credit Fund disclosing entry into an indenture for a $400M issuance of 6.500% Notes due 2031. The notes are senior unsecured obligations ranking pari passu with other unsecured debt and junior to secured debt. Interest is payable semi-annually. No change of control or special situation is triggered; the filing is a standard debt offering under Item 1.01 and 2.03. There are no M&A, activist, or restructuring elements. The filing is classified as 'None' because ordinary debt offerings fall outside special-situations categories.
